## Join the Robot Control Lab

Our group at UT Dallas studies robotics, nonlinear control, and machine learning, with a focus on robotic locomotion and manipulation. We bring together mathematical modeling, optimization, and learning to understand and control dynamical systems.

## Current openings

There are no open positions at this time.

Future openings will be posted here with the role, qualifications, and application instructions. Please check this page for updates.
